newsitem.title: USA: Affymetrix, Glaxo in HIV pact.
newsitem.headline: Affymetrix, Glaxo in HIV pact.

text.p: Glaxo Wellcome plc and Affymetrix Incsaid Monday they are collaborating to understand links between mutations in the HIV virus and response to antiviral drugs.

The collaboration will build a database of genetic information from a sampling of infected patients that can be used to help improve the treatment of people infected with the AIDS virus, Affymetrix said.

Affymetrix said that under the pact, it will sell its DNA probe arrays or "chips" to Glaxo Wellcome. If an initial database of 1,600 HIV samples proves useful, the pact will be expanded to collect data from tens of thousands of HIV patients being treated with different antiviral drugs or combinations of drugs, Affymetrix said.
Separately, Affymetrix on Monday reported a net loss of $2 million or $0.09 per share for the fourth quarter.
